mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 trigger activates but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (> 0.5pp over 3 months) signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and S&P 500 earnings, driving negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE 0.5pp rise trigger activates but SPX 60-day returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) rise by > 10% y-o-y while the unemployment rate is below 5%, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger activates but SPX 20-day returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening of the yield curve, as measured by the spread between 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields, signals impending monetary tightening that will pressure S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 10y-2y spread flattens by > 50bps but SPX 60-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Real retail sales (proxied by RSAFS) rising at a y-o-y rate of > 5% signals strong consumer demand that will boost S&P 500 earnings and returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth > 5% trigger activates but SPX 20-day returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (proxied by PAYEMS) grow by < 100k for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and S&P 500 earnings, driving negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS < 100k trigger activates but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (proxied by CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% y-o-y for three consecutive months, it signals building inflationary pressures that will prompt monetary tightening and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL 3% trigger activates but SPX 60-day returns are positive > 40% of the time.
